title: 第3083章 虚空种族人的天赋第3082章 虚空绞杀大阵
content_zh:
“这是什么？”
不但姜家子弟感到奇怪，就连真界界域的各族生灵，也同样感到无比震撼。
怎么会有如此强大威势，从那里出来，并且看样子还不是器灵一类的东西。
而且，看它爆发出来的威势，似乎还是个有生命的智慧生物。
可是，按照阵法所凝聚的器灵来可能，那是不可能会爆发这样威势出来的。
因此，在虚空种族人布下虚空绞杀大阵之后，竟然会出现这样的智慧生物，怎么都会让人感到奇怪。
不过，很快，他们就看到了，那道散发出强大气势的是什么东西。
“吼！”
一声兽吼声，从那道虚影里面发出。
随后，一道庞大得可以笼罩住这里半片虚空的巨大身影，已经从虚空深处出来。
“砰！”
这是一头，有着强壮四肢，三个头颅，类似巨龙，却不是巨龙的生物。
身上布满散发出道道黑色光芒的鳞片，有着一条长长的尾巴！
刚才就是它的尾巴一甩，狠狠地轰击在了姜氏界域防御阵法上面。
“快！加紧防御！”
被这头虚空怪物一击，防御阵法立刻开始晃动起来。
而且，姜喜明显地感觉得到，自己体内的法则之力，正在快速地消耗。
这让得姜喜心里一惊，这头怪物只是随意的一击，竟然就给防御阵法造成了这么大的压力。
那等到它全力进行攻击，岂不是很快就可以把防御阵法给击破？
怪不得那些怪人，对于能够在这里布下阵法来对抗防御阵法，会显得那么高兴。

姜喜可不知道，虚空种族人之所以高兴，可不是因为能够用虚空绞杀大阵来对付防御阵法。
那是因为，只要在这里布下虚空绞杀大阵，把他们一直镇压着的虚空异兽给召唤出来。
那就是等于是在宣告，他们虚空种族人要在虚空界域里面重现。
而且，他们此次重现，还是在得到江流，这位新任混沌虚空主神的庇护之下。
那对于他们虚空种族人来说，可就完全无惧其他种族生灵的窥视。
毕竟，对于一些种族生灵来说，他们虚空种族人可算得上，是一种完美的修炼资源。
之前他们虚空种族人之所以会落魄，可不只是因为被混沌神族盯上的原因。
更是有着一些生灵，盯上了他们虚空种族人的天赋，想要对他们进行掠夺。
这才让得虚空种族人，自从丢失族地之后，就再也不敢现身，只能在虚空缝隙里面流浪的真正原因。
因为他们虚空种族人，除了能够修炼虚空法则之力外，更是能够控制远古的虚空异兽。
这就是他们虚空种族人，之所以能够在虚空界域被开辟出来之前，就已经在这片虚空生活的主要原因。
content_en:
"What is this?"
Not only the children of the Jiang family felt strange, but even the creatures of all races in the real world were also extremely shocked.
How could there be such a powerful force coming out of there, and it doesn't look like it's a weapon spirit.
Moreover, judging from the power it erupts, it seems to be a living, intelligent creature.
However, based on the weapon spirit condensed by the formation, it is impossible for it to explode with such power.
Therefore, after the void race people set up the void strangulation formation, it was strange that such intelligent creatures would appear.
However, soon, they saw what was emitting a powerful aura.
"Roar!"
A beast roar came from the phantom.
Then, a huge figure that could cover half of the void here came out from the depths of the void.
"Bang!"
This is a creature with strong limbs and three heads that resembles a giant dragon, but is not a giant dragon.
The body is covered with scales that emit black light, and has a long tail!
Just now, it flicked its tail and hit Jiang's boundary defense formation hard.
"Quick! Step up your defense!"
After being hit by this void monster, the defensive formation immediately began to shake.
Moreover, Jiang Xi could clearly feel that the power of law in his body was rapidly being consumed.
This shocked Jiang Xi. This monster put so much pressure on the defensive formation with just a casual blow.
Then when it attacks with all its strength, wouldn't it be able to quickly defeat the defensive formation?
No wonder those weirdos are so happy to be able to set up formations here to counter defensive formations.
Jiang Xike didn't know that the reason why the people of the void race were happy was not because they could use the void strangulation formation to deal with the defensive formation.
That's because as long as they set up a void strangulation formation here, they can summon the void beasts they have been suppressing.
That is tantamount to announcing that their void race people will reappear in the void realm.
Moreover, their reappearance was under the protection of Jiang Liu, the new Lord God of Chaos Void.
For the people of their void race, they have no fear of the prying eyes of other races.
After all, for some racial creatures, their Void race can be regarded as a perfect cultivation resource.
The reason why people from the void race were in such a state of despair before was not just because they were targeted by the Chaos Gods.
There are even some creatures who are eyeing the talents of people from their void race and want to plunder them.
This is the real reason why the people of the Void race, since they lost their clan land, no longer dare to show up, and can only wander in the gaps in the void.
Because people of their Void race, in addition to being able to cultivate the power of the Void Law, are also able to control ancient Void beasts.
This is the main reason why people of their Void race were able to live in this void before the void realm was opened up.
